# PulseDev AI Bug Fix: Click a UI Bug, Agent Fixes It in 2026

PulseDev turns a clicked broken element on localhost into a plain-text bug report your AI agent fixes in seconds. See how it works and how creators ship faster.

Creator OS · October 28, 2026· Updated October 30, 2026· 10min read

PulseDev AI bug fix means clicking a broken element on your localhost site and getting a plain-text bug report an AI agent can act on. You click, PulseDev describes the problem, and Claude Code, Codex or Gemini edits the code. You review the diff, then ship. No screen recording, no vague “the button looks off” message. [...] ```
 Your site on localhost | | click the broken element v +---------------------+ | PulseDev | captures the element, page | (browser overlay) | and problem context +---------------------+ | | plain-text bug report v +---------------------+ | Claude Code / | reads the report, | Codex / Gemini | edits the code +---------------------+ | | diff v +---------------------+ | You review | approve, edit or reject +---------------------+ | v Ship
```

Click a UI bug, hand a text report to your agent, review the diff.

## What Is PulseDev AI Bug Fix and How Does It Work?

PulseDev is a bug reporting layer for sites you run locally: you click what is broken, and it produces a text description an AI coding agent can fix from. [...] ## FAQ

### What is PulseDev AI bug fix?

PulseDev is a tool you run against your site on localhost. You click the broken UI element and it produces a plain-text bug report that an AI coding agent like Claude Code, Codex or Gemini can read and fix. You then review the resulting diff before anything is applied.

### How do I connect PulseDev to Claude Code or Codex?

There is no special connector to wire up, because the output is text. You copy the report PulseDev generates and paste it into your agent session, or save it as a file inside the repo and point the agent at that file. The agent reads the element name, page and symptom, then searches your code. Follow the install steps on the PulseDev listing for the current browser setup.
